Measured migration path

Assess, convert, and test before you switch.

01 · read-only first

Inventory services and scan the code that uses them.

Record services, layers, authentication, and data sources. Scan the application or script for supported patterns and dependencies, without changing the source.

Service inventory + code scan → migration scope
02 · compatibility review

Choose a migration target and review the gaps.

Compare required operations with the compatibility evidence and code-conversion reports. Separate automatic rewrites from manual changes, including widgets, authentication, and processing semantics.

Open the compatibility evidence →
03 · bounded conversion

Publish the data and convert supported code.

Connect an existing database table or import the selected service data. Run the JavaScript/TypeScript or Python conversion tool for the chosen workflow in a working branch, inspect its diff and report, and complete the flagged manual steps.

Review migration evidence →
04 · side-by-side testing

Build the application. Run the workflow.

Test the converted app or script against the published layers. Verify queries, widgets, authentication, and processing outputs alongside the existing workflow before calling the migration complete.

Not yet Estate-wide behavioral comparison reporting
05 · controlled cutover

Switch the validated workflow, not just its service URL.

Deploy the reviewed application or script and update its connections once the workflow passes. Keep the previous application version and services available for recovery, observe the result, and expand incrementally.
